استبيحا (form X)
# اُسْتُبِيحَا (ustubīḥā) /us.tu.biː.ħaː/: third-person masculine dual past passive of اِسْتَبَاحَ (istabāḥa)
# اِسْتَبِيحَا (istabīḥā) /is.ta.biː.ħaː/: second-person dual imperative of اِسْتَبَاحَ (istabāḥa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
